about: Fingerprint of the overworld's generation, made by tools/worldgen_check.py on a fresh world (seed 'worldgen', 20 m per block).
Compare with that tool; it moves only through its --update (first baseline, info-only changes), --accept "<reason>" (new-chunks-only
additions, recorded under 'accepted') and --update --force-terrain "<reason>" (continuity-breaking, recorded as terrain).
Add --golden to refresh the golden chunk areas. Commit the result with a message saying why generation was allowed to change.

accepted.reason: Fowl Play's birds for atmosphere (docs/design.md: Atmosphere): 11 species on TFC land, shores and fresh water, each gated by a TFC fauna climate rule (kubejs/data/fowlplay/tfc/fauna, kubejs/startup_scripts/fowl_play.js); its duck and penguin get no biomes (TFC has both). They spawn in Fowl Play's own mob categories, which only spawn at runtime, so old and new chunks get them alike; they drop only feathers.

accepted.reason: New caves (docs/design.md: Caves; docs/caves.md), landing before the first long-lived world. Shape: TFC's noise caves rewritten (spaghetti and noodles off, chambers twice the size, three regional styles of ~2 km: chambers, great caverns, shafts), TFC's carvers fewer and bigger (cave 0.005, deep_cave 0.015, canyon 0.02 and deeper), and a karst-only carver (limestone, dolomite, chalk, marble) added to all TFC biomes by pack:cave_carvers. Decoration (new-chunks-only, folded in here because the golden census sees it too): TFC mossy cobble with moss carpets and glow-berry cave vines in warm wet caves, glow lichen below y 0, calcite under karst ceilings, TFC's ice caves where it is -4 C or colder, denser TFC rock spikes and columns.
